page_title: BRE 2-0 ANG | Brest v Angers 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
90+4' Kenny Lala (Brest) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+4' Kenny Lala (Brest) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and Brest manage to earn a corner.

90+2' Yahia Fofana pulls off a great save to deny Kenny Lala (Brest) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is penalised for a foul. Abdelatif Kherradji had a clear view and blows his whistle.
89' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
89' Corner kick. Farid El Melali (Angers) is ready to send the ball into the box.
86' The corner by Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
86' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Farid El Melali (Angers), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Angers.
82' Emmanuel Biumla (Angers) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Abdelatif Kherradji had an easy-decision to make.
81' The free kick into the penalty area from Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) is cleared.
77' Eric Roy is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) suffers an injury and Abdoulaye Ndiaye comes on.
76' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Marius Courcoul.
76' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Jim Allevinah and he is replaced by Zinedine Ferhat (Angers).
76' Here comes a substitution. Florent Hanin is given a rest as he is replaced by Jacques Ekomie (Angers).
75' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
74' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
74' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
71' Florent Hanin (Angers) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
71' Emmanuel Biumla (Angers) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
70' Dangerous play by Ludovic Ajorque (Brest). Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Ibrahima Niane (Angers) replaces Esteban Lepaul.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Farid El Melali (Angers) replaces Carlens Arcus.
60' 2 - 0 Goal! Romain Faivre (Brest) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 2:0.
59' Romain Faivre (Brest) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Yahia Fofana to make a comfortable save.
55' Romain Faivre (Brest) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
53' Kenny Lala (Brest) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
51' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul.
49' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

49' Kenny Lala (Brest) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Angers.
45+5' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
45+2' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Abdallah Sima is substituted due to injury. Eric Roy gives a chance to Romain Faivre (Brest).
42' Abdallah Sima (Brest) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
40' Golden opportunity! Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
39' The resulting set piece from Angers is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
35' Goal, no wait. Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for handball and Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) can't celebrate. Disallowed goal.
34' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
31' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
30' Half-chance! Abdallah Sima (Brest) plays a pass into the box, but Yahia Fofana reacts well to snuff out the attack.
28' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.
27' Florent Hanin (Angers) makes a strong challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Brest.
26' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
24' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
23' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) steps up to send the ball in.
23' An attempted cross from Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Brest are awarded a corner kick.
22' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

22' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) failed to beat Yahia Fofana, who expertly stopped his header from the centre of the box towards the roof of the net after a rebound. Brest have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
20' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) prepares to take a corner kick.
19' 1 - 0 Gooal! Mathias Pereira Lage takes over corner duties. Abdallah Sima (Brest) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the top right corner. 1:0.
16' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Massadio Haidara (Brest) but poses no threat.
16' Mahdi Camara (Brest) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Abdelatif Kherradji interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
10' Kenny Lala (Brest) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
9' Abdallah Sima (Brest) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
8' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
7' Mahdi Camara (Brest) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' A lofted cross from Jim Allevinah (Angers) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
5' What a big chance! Esteban Lepaul (Angers) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
1' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
1' The referee blows his whistle as Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) was too aggressive in his challenge.
1' The match has just started.
Brest will kick-off.
Abdelatif Kherradji will officiate today.
